ocf.text: Net cash used in operating activities was $50,886 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. This was primarily attributable to a net loss of $16,921, adjusted for non-cash amortization expense of $9,560, an increase in project in progress of $16,100, and a decrease in accounts payable of $27,425. There was no net cash provided by (used in) operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

net sales.heading: Revenue
net sales.text: For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the company generated revenue in the amount of $41,200 from subscription fees paid by clients. Subscription sales commenced in July 2026, and revenue for the period reflected the initial delivery of subscription services to a limited number of customers. During the three months ended September 30, 2025, the Company generated no revenue.

profile.name: Bravalo Corp
profile.category: Non-accelerated filer · Smaller reporting company · Emerging growth company

intro.text: Bravalo Corporation (“Bravalo”) was incorporated in Wyoming on October 27, 2025. The Company develops and provides HeadLab, an artificial intelligence-powered software service accessible through an application programming interface (API). HeadLab is designed to assist users in generating, adapting, modifying, and optimizing text content, including headlines and other written content for digital communication and marketing purposes. The Company completed the initial development of HeadLab on April 24, 2026, and began generating revenue from subscription-based API access in July 2026.
